nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of contract owner, written by constructor and transferOwnership
ERC20Token.balances: mapping(address=>uint256) token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom
ERC20Token.allowed: nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances, mutated by approve and transferFrom
ERC20Token.transferable: boolean gate controlling whether transfers are allowed
ERC20.totalSupply: total token supply, set in OYT constructor to totalSupplyCap
OYT.totalSupplyCap: 2*10**8 * 10**decimals, initial issuance cap
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership and allowance keys
Owned.transferOwnership(address _owner) onlyOwner: reassigns owner state variable
ERC20Token.setTransferable(bool _transferable) onlyOwner: toggles the transfer gate
ERC20Token.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) canTransfer: moves tokens between balances
ERC20Token.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) canTransfer: delegated transfer spending allowance
ERC20Token.approve(address _spender, uint _value): sets allowance, reverts on non-zero-to-non-zero change
ERC20Token.balanceOf(address _owner) view: reads balances mapping
ERC20Token.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view: reads allowed mapping
ERC20Token fallback () external payable: always reverts to disallow plain Ether transfers
OYT constructor(address _issuer): mints totalSupplyCap to issuer and emits Transfer
Arithmetic balance mutation in transfer: balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value)
Arithmetic balance/allowance mutation in transferFrom: three sub/add operations on balances and allowed
Privileged state write: owner = _owner after onlyOwner guard (access control surface)
Privileged state write: transferable = _transferable after onlyOwner guard (access control surface)
Unconditional revert("disallow eth transfer in") in payable fallback
_owner parameter of transferOwnership, becomes the new owner
_transferable parameter of setTransferable, written into transferable
_to parameter of transfer, recipient of tokens
_value parameter of transfer, amount moved from msg.sender
_from parameter of transferFrom, source of tokens
_to parameter of transferFrom, recipient of tokens
_value parameter of transferFrom, amount moved and allowance spent
_spender parameter of approve, granted allowance key
_value parameter of approve, allowance amount written to allowed
_owner parameter of balanceOf, lookup key for balances
_spender parameter of allowance, lookup key for allowed
